name: Chicken au Poivre (Creamy Peppercorn Sauce)
ingredients_verbatim: 2 large chicken breasts, skinless & boneless (250-300g / 8-10oz each)
2 tsp whole black peppercorns, coarsely crushed
1 1/2 cups beef stock / broth, low sodium
why: Classic one-pan seared chicken with a pepper-cream pan sauce; 442 cal / 35g protein / 3g carbs per serving lands dead-center of the band with excellent protein and near-zero carbs. Structurally low-carb (meat + fat + broth, no starch). Signature brandy/cognac has no board home - a deliberate pricer-lane test flag.
